articles.title: The Latest: Day 1 of Republican midterm convention begins ahead of Trump’s keynote address
articles.description: Republicans are gathering in Dallas for a unique two-day midterm convention, focusing on President Donald Trump. Trump plans to speak both nights and Vice President JD Vance will also address attendees. The event aims to boost Republican candidates by highlighting Trump's first two years in office. Trump believes running on his record is the GOP's best strategy despite low approval ratings. Meanwhile, Democrats are planning counterprogramming. Trump has commented on high oil prices due to the Iran war, suggesting they won't drop until after the midterms. The war, now in its seventh month, has been widely criticized.
